purpose: Govern pilot administrative intervention, cross-domain audit visibility, stuck-work diagnosis, and bounded recovery without creating a parallel authority or canonical ledger.

canonMappings.claim: Administrative UI or role does not authorize consequential mutation or audit access; actions and reads resolve through AuthorityEvaluator.

Operational recovery does not silently rewrite canonical history; it probes an existing failed request, preserves source lineage, and retries only the exact original authorized operation when no effect is observed.
Accepted admin and recovery requests are actor-bound and replay-safe; conflicting request-id reuse fails closed and recovery cannot duplicate an observed effect.

Audit views and stuck-work diagnosis are explicitly non-authoritative, separately read-authorized, and disclose source lineage plus freshness/staleness across member, obligation, payment, inventory, fulfillment, remedy, and economics domains.
SW1-09 adds an operational façade and typed read adapters over existing canonical boundaries and does not introduce new canonical meanings.

productionBoundary: No production launch, live funds/provider activation, blanket administrator authority, or claim of complete distributed transaction fencing.
